description: This file implements the CurrencyDataLoader class, which handles loading, caching, and providing currency exchange rate data for a calculator application. It manages data retrieval from cache or web, parsing JSON responses, and maintaining currency units and ratios, including localization and user preferences.

classes.name: CurrencyDataLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, caching, and providing currency exchange rate data, including localization, user preferences, and network management.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data loader with optional forced response language.

methods.name: ~CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters network change handlers.

methods.name: LoadData
methods.description: Initiates loading of currency data from cache or web asynchronously.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Checks if data loading has completed.

methods.name: LoadedFromCache
methods.description: Checks if data was loaded from cache.

methods.name: LoadedFromWeb
methods.description: Checks if data was loaded from web.

methods.name: ResetLoadStatus
methods.description: Resets the load status to not loaded.

methods.name: SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for view model updates.

methods.name: GetCurrencySymbols
methods.description: Retrieves symbols for two currency units.

methods.name: RoundCurrencyRatio
methods.description: Rounds a currency ratio to a suitable number of decimal places.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatioEquality
methods.description: Returns string representations of the ratio between two currency units.

methods.name: GetCurrencyTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a localized timestamp string of the last currency data update.
